problem_summary.summary: Capture every four-directionally connected O region that has no connection to the board boundary, changing it to X in place.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: an m by n board of 'X' and 'O'. Modify the board in place; return nothing.
constraints: board has m rows and n columns

brute_force.explanation: For each O cell, run a fresh BFS over its full O component. If that search finds no boundary cell, scan the reached cells again and capture them. This direct per-cell baseline repeats component traversals.
brute_force.correctness_idea: An O component is capturable exactly when none of its cells lies on the boundary. Every component is fully enumerated from any of its cells, so the test decides whether to flip precisely the enclosed regions.
brute_force.time_complexity: O((mn)^2) worst case because each O cell can trigger a full-grid component traversal.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(mn) auxiliary for one visited matrix, queue, and component list.

optimized.explanation: Start BFS from every boundary O and mark all reachable O cells with a temporary symbol. In a final pass, flip remaining O cells to X and restore temporary marks to O.
optimized.correctness_idea: An O survives if and only if its component is connected to a boundary O. The boundary searches mark exactly those components; all unmarked O cells are enclosed and therefore captured.
optimized.time_complexity: O(mn): each cell is examined a constant number of times.
optimized.space_complexity: O(mn) auxiliary worst case for the queue; the board stores visitation marks in place.

steps.condition: Only the O at (3,1) lies on the boundary.
All its in-bounds neighbors are X.
steps.action: No further cells are marked; the other three O cells have no boundary path.

steps.condition: Unmarked O is enclosed; '#' is boundary-connected.
steps.action: Flip enclosed cells and restore the safe cell.

edge_cases.handling: Every O touches the boundary and is restored unchanged.
No boundary queue entries are added and no cell changes.

edge_cases.case: One enclosed O component and a separate boundary component
edge_cases.handling: Only boundary-reachable O cells receive the temporary mark and survive.

edge_cases.case: Corner O encountered from two boundary scans
edge_cases.handling: It is marked on first enqueue, so it enters the queue only once.
